David Attenborough narrates a look at life on each continent, revealing how each distinct land mass has shaped the creatures found there, beginning with Antarctica.
David Attenborough looks at life in Asia, with footage of walruses gathering in huge numbers in the frozen north and brown bears roaming around remote Russian volcanoes.
David Attenborough looks at life in South America, featuring footage of pumas, Andean bears, poison dart frogs, anacondas and swifts.
David Attenborough looks at the wildlife of Australia, with footage of kangaroos and wombats braving snowstorms, and reptiles drinking through their skin in the desert.

Hitler's Island Madness: Uncovering hidden structures built by the Nazis. The first edition focuses on Guernsey, which Hitler occupied and fortified over the course of five years.
A D-Day Coverup?: A mile-and-a half of recently-excavated trenches, bunkers, barracks, and gun encasements near Pointe du Hoc, which tell a new story of D-Day.
Secret U-Boat Base?: The Spanish island of Villa Winter, which was suspected of being a port for German U-boats and part of a larger plan to invade the United States.
One of the largest Nazi bunkers ever constructed, outside the French town of Watten, a missile facility with storage for 108 missiles and two launch pads.
